patch_description: This version keeps the direct-link reward, but adds a small estimate of the value of a link as part of a transit route. For two-hop routes, it ranks candidate transit nodes by estimated edge and node congestion, then rewards only a few low-congestion alternatives per demand. The sparse, deterministic construction keeps the coupling count well below the limit while giving the energy a more load-aware signal for sampling and move ranking. The degree penalty remains external to this function.
